heading.en: Seeing the very small and the very far
heading.kn: ಅತಿ ಸಣ್ಣದನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಅತಿ ದೂರದ್ದನ್ನು ನೋಡುವುದು

hook.en: Two lenses can show you a bacterium or the rings of Saturn. The microscope and the telescope use the same idea in opposite ways.
hook.kn: ಎರಡು ಮಸೂರಗಳು ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾವನ್ನೂ ಶನಿಯ ಉಂಗುರಗಳನ್ನೂ ತೋರಿಸಬಲ್ಲವು. ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮದರ್ಶಕ ಮತ್ತು ದೂರದರ್ಶಕ ಒಂದೇ ತತ್ವವನ್ನು ವಿರುದ್ಧ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಸುತ್ತವೆ.

objectives.en: Find magnifying power of simple and compound microscopes
Find magnifying power and length of a telescope

narration.en: Two lenses can show you a bacterium or the rings of Saturn. The microscope and the telescope use the same idea in opposite ways.
narration.kn: ಎರಡು ಮಸೂರಗಳು ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾವನ್ನೂ ಶನಿಯ ಉಂಗುರಗಳನ್ನೂ ತೋರಿಸಬಲ್ಲವು. ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮದರ್ಶಕ ಮತ್ತು ದೂರದರ್ಶಕ ಒಂದೇ ತತ್ವವನ್ನು ವಿರುದ್ಧ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಸುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: A simple microscope is a convex lens held close to the eye. Its magnifying power is $m = 1 + D/f$ with the image at the near point ($D = 25$ cm) and $m = D/f$ with the image at infinity. A compound microscope has a short-focus objective that forms a real, magnified image, and an eyepiece that magnifies it further: $m \approx (L/f_o)(D/f_e)$, where $L$ is the tube length.
body.kn: ಸರಳ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮದರ್ಶಕದ ವರ್ಧನಾ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ m = 1 + D/f (ಸಮೀಪ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಂಬ). ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮದರ್ಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ m ≈ (L/f_o)(D/f_e).

narration.en: A simple microscope is a convex lens held close to the eye. Its magnifying power is m = 1 + D/f with the image at the near point (D = 25 cm) and m = D/f with the image at infinity. A compound microscope has a short-focus objective that forms a real, magnified image, and an eyepiece that magnifies it further: m \approx (L/f_o)(D/f_e), where L is the tube length.
narration.kn: ಸರಳ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮದರ್ಶಕದ ವರ್ಧನಾ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ m = 1 + D/f (ಸಮೀಪ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಂಬ). ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮದರ್ಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ m ≈ (L/f_o)(D/f_e).

body.en: An astronomical telescope has a long-focus objective and a short-focus eyepiece. In normal adjustment (final image at infinity) its magnifying power is $m = f_o/f_e$ and its length is $f_o + f_e$. Reflecting telescopes use a concave mirror as the objective: there is no chromatic aberration, a paraboloid mirror removes spherical aberration, and a large mirror is easier to support than a large lens.
body.kn: ಖಗೋಳ ದೂರದರ್ಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ m = f_o/f_e ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ದ f_o + f_e. ಪ್ರತಿಫಲಕ ದೂರದರ್ಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ ವರ್ಣ ವಿಪಥನ ಇಲ್ಲ.

points.en: Large objective aperture gives better resolution and brightness

narration.en: An astronomical telescope has a long-focus objective and a short-focus eyepiece. In normal adjustment (final image at infinity) its magnifying power is m = f_o/f_e and its length is f_o + f_e. Reflecting telescopes use a concave mirror as the objective: there is no chromatic aberration, a paraboloid mirror removes spherical aberration, and a large mirror is easier to support than a large lens.
narration.kn: ಖಗೋಳ ದೂರದರ್ಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ m = f_o/f_e ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ದ f_o + f_e. ಪ್ರತಿಫಲಕ ದೂರದರ್ಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ ವರ್ಣ ವಿಪಥನ ಇಲ್ಲ.

problem.en: A compound microscope has f_o = 0.8 cm, f_e = 2.5 cm and tube length 16 cm. Find its magnifying power for the final image at infinity.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A compound microscope has f_o = 0.8 cm, f_e = 2.5 cm and tube length 16 cm. Find its magnifying power for the final image at infinity.

problem.en: A telescope has an objective of focal length 150 cm and an eyepiece of 5 cm. Find its magnifying power and length in normal adjustment.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A telescope has an objective of focal length 150 cm and an eyepiece of 5 cm. Find its magnifying power and length in normal adjustment.

body.en: Microscope: both lenses short. Telescope: objective long, eyepiece short. If you remember that m grows when the eyepiece focal length is small, you have both.

narration.en: Microscope vs telescope. Microscope: both lenses short. Telescope: objective long, eyepiece short. If you remember that m grows when the eyepiece focal length is small, you have both.

narration.en: Now the CBSE board pattern: assertion–reason and case-based questions. For assertion–reason, first decide whether each statement is true, then whether the reason explains the assertion. For case-based questions, read the situation carefully and apply the idea.

points.en: Simple microscope: m = 1 + D/f at the near point.
points.kn: ಸರಳ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮದರ್ಶಕ: ಸಮೀಪ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ m = 1 + D/f.

points.en: Telescope: m = f_o/f_e, length f_o + f_e.
points.kn: ದೂರದರ್ಶಕ: m = f_o/f_e, ಉದ್ದ f_o + f_e.

narration.en: Recap. Simple microscope: m = 1 + D/f at the near point. Compound microscope: m ≈ (L/f_o)(D/f_e). Telescope: m = f_o/f_e, length f_o + f_e.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸರಳ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮದರ್ಶಕ: ಸಮೀಪ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ m = 1 + D/f. ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮದರ್ಶಕ: m ≈ (L/f_o)(D/f_e). ದೂರದರ್ಶಕ: m = f_o/f_e, ಉದ್ದ f_o + f_e.
